description: Capa de base de datos: 5 migraciones SQL (timestamps > 20261002000003) que introducen product_varieties, rates.variety_id (doble indice unico parcial), blocks.variety_id + trigger de validacion robusto al orden, picking_records.payment_unit/paid_quantity_kg con backfill seguro, y los feature flags kg_payment/product_varieties. Base de todo lo demas; independiente del resto salvo que shared/functions dependen de esta forma. Preserva invariantes: no toca quantity CHECK>0, rate amount CHECK>0, ni el trigger prevent_paid_settlement_update.
steps: M1: crear supabase/migrations/20261003000001_create_product_varieties.sql espejando box_types (20260927000001): tabla product_varieties con id UUID PK, organization_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations ON DELETE RESTRICT, product_id UUID NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, status entity_status DEFAULT 'active', created_at/updated_at; FK compuesta fk_variety_product_org (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; UNIQUE uq_product_varieties_id_org (id, organization_id); indices en organization_id, product_id, status; indice unico parcial uq_product_varieties_name_per_product ON (product_id, lower(name)) WHERE status='active'; triggers trg_product_varieties_updated_at (update_updated_at_column) y trg_set_org_id_product_varieties (set_organization_id); RLS ENABLE + policies admin_all_product_varieties (is_platform_admin OR (is_admin AND org match)) y member_read_active_product_varieties (platform_admin OR (supervisor/crew_lead/worker AND status=active AND org match)). Comentario de encabezado con reversibilidad (DROP TABLE ... CASCADE).

M2: crear 20261003000002_add_rates_variety_id.sql: ALTER TABLE rates ADD COLUMN variety_id UUID nullable; FK compuesta fk_rates_variety_org (variety_id, organization_id) REFERENCES product_varieties(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; CREATE INDEX idx_rates_variety ON rates(variety_id) WHERE variety_id IS NOT NULL; DROP INDEX idx_rates_product_current; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rates_product_current_no_variety ON rates(product_id) WHERE status='current' AND variety_id IS NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rates_product_variety_current ON rates(product_id, variety_id) WHERE status='current' AND variety_id IS NOT NULL. Sin backfill. No tocar amount CHECK>0.

M3: crear 20261003000003_add_blocks_variety_id.sql: ALTER TABLE blocks ADD COLUMN variety_id UUID nullable; FK compuesta fk_blocks_variety_org (variety_id, organization_id) REFERENCES product_varieties(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; CREATE INDEX idx_blocks_variety ON blocks(variety_id) WHERE variety_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_block_variety() que hace v_org := COALESCE(NEW.organization_id, current_org_id()) (robusto al orden de triggers BEFORE; RAISE ORG_CONTEXT_REQUIRED si NULL), calcula v_has_active_varieties (EXISTS product_varieties del producto+org con status active), y: si NEW.variety_id NOT NULL valida que exista en el tenant (VARIETY_NOT_FOUND) y pertenezca a NEW.product_id (VARIETY_PRODUCT_MISMATCH); si NULL y hay variedades activas RAISE VARIETY_REQUIRED; CREATE TRIGGER trg_validate_block_variety BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF variety_id, product_id ON blocks FOR EACH ROW. Documentar reversibilidad.

M4: crear 20261003000004_add_picking_payment_fields.sql en ESTE orden exacto: ALTER TABLE picking_records ADD COLUMN payment_unit unit_measure (nullable); ADD COLUMN paid_quantity_kg NUMERIC(10,3) nullable; UPDATE picking_records SET payment_unit='box' WHERE payment_unit IS NULL (backfill, incluye filas de auditoria); ALTER COLUMN payment_unit SET NOT NULL; ADD CONSTRAINT chk_picking_paid_kg CHECK ((payment_unit='box' AND paid_quantity_kg IS NULL) OR (payment_unit='kg' AND paid_quantity_kg IS NOT NULL AND paid_quantity_kg>0)); CREATE INDEX idx_picking_payment_unit ON picking_records(payment_unit). NO tocar el CHECK existente de quantity>0.

M5: crear 20261003000005_feature_flags_kg_varieties.sql: INSERT INTO platform_feature_flags (key, name, description, category, strategy, enabled) VALUES ('kg_payment', 'Pago por kilo', <descripcion>, 'cosecha', 'org_override', false), ('product_varieties', 'Variedades de producto', <descripcion>, 'cosecha', 'org_override', false) ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING.
acceptance_criteria: Los 5 archivos existen con timestamps 20261003000001..05, estrictamente > 20261002000003 (CA-25).
Con contenedores: 'npx supabase db reset' aplica las 5 migraciones en orden sin error.
product_varieties tiene UUID PK, FK compuesta de tenant, UNIQUE(id,organization_id), RLS habilitada y los dos policies (CA-11, CA-23, CA-26).

rates tiene exactamente los dos indices unicos parciales nuevos y ya no idx_rates_product_current; insertar dos 'current' del mismo sujeto (producto sin variedad, o par producto+variedad) es rechazado (CA-17).
blocks.variety_id existe nullable; el trigger valida pertenencia y exige/prohibe variedad segun variedades activas del producto (CA-13, CA-14).
picking_records: payment_unit NOT NULL con todas las filas existentes en 'box' y paid_quantity_kg NULL; CHECK chk_picking_paid_kg rechaza kg sin kilos y box con kilos (CA-04, CA-09, CA-24).
platform_feature_flags contiene kg_payment y product_varieties con strategy='org_override' y enabled=false (CA-20).
Ningun dato existente cambia de valor; quantity CHECK>0 y amount CHECK>0 intactos (NFR-01).
verification: npm install --legacy-peer-deps (si faltan deps). macOS no tiene 'timeout': no envolver comandos.

Con Rancher Desktop en modo dockerd(moby): 'npx supabase db reset' aplica M1-M5 sin error. Verificar en psql/Studio: estructura de product_varieties, existencia de los indices unicos parciales de rates, columnas payment_unit/paid_quantity_kg, y SELECT key,enabled FROM platform_feature_flags WHERE key IN ('kg_payment','product_varieties').

Si el entorno de contenedores no esta disponible, registrar el motivo en findings y revisar el SQL contra las migraciones existentes (box_types 20260927000001, feature_flags 20260913000002), confirmando orden, FK compuestas, RLS y el orden backfill->NOT NULL->CHECK de M4.
findings:
Las 5 migraciones (20261003000001..05) se crearon y se aplicaron en orden con 'npx supabase db reset' (Rancher/docker.sock OK). ÉXITO: db reset termina limpio incluyendo seed. VERIFICADO en psql (via docker exec supabase_db_control-picking): (1) platform_feature_flags tiene kg_payment y product_varieties con strategy=org_override, enabled=false. (2) rates: idx_rates_product_current eliminado; existen uq_rates_product_current_no_variety, uq_rates_product_variety_current e idx_rates_variety; insertar dos 'current' del mismo producto sin variedad es rechazado por el unique parcial. (3) picking_records: payment_unit NOT NULL, paid_quantity_kg nullable; las 9 filas sembradas quedaron en 'box' con paid_quantity_kg NULL; chk_picking_paid_kg rechaza kg-sin-kilos y box-con-kilos (probado). (4) product_varieties: RLS ON + policies admin_all_product_varieties y member_read_active_product_varieties. (5) blocks.variety_id nullable + trigger trg_validate_block_variety. (6) INVARIANTES INTACTAS: picking_records_quantity_check (quantity>0), rates_amount_check (amount>0) y trigger trg_settlements_immutable_when_paid presentes y sin modificar.

ACCIÓN ADJUNTA NECESARIA PARA PASOS SIGUIENTES: supabase/seed.sql insertaba picking_records SIN payment_unit, lo que rompía db reset tras M4 (payment_unit NOT NULL sin DEFAULT, por diseño). Se añadió payment_unit='box' a los dos INSERT INTO picking_records del seed (bloques sur-berries y default). No se añadió DEFAULT a la columna para respetar el design.md (M4: ADD nullable -> backfill -> SET NOT NULL, sin default). Si pasos posteriores siembran picking_records por kg, deben incluir payment_unit='kg' y paid_quantity_kg>0.
